text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen draws near. Her opponent is
T.M. Opera O, who grows stronger by the day...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I know it won't be easy!
Still, I want to grow strong enough to face it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Speed! Toughness! Confidence!
More, give me more! Hyaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This ability to steadily build upon honest, hard effort is Narita Top Road's strength. However..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, gasp*...
Trainer... What's my time...?
choice_data_list: It's no use... I can't take any more.
It's no use, we can't go any further than this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just can't reach a level
that clearly surpasses TM Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even making full use of a trainer's knowledge, and despite Narita Top Road's earnest devotion, no breakthrough could be found.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Is it impossible for us...?
Even after joining forces this much...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, did I say something strange?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words sparked an idea.
If we can't do it on our own, we have no choice
but to borrow 'strength from outside ourselves.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Just like before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Top Road understood as well.
It felt a bit pathetic to rely on her again, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Being blessed with the finest mentor was a major advantage that only they possessed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's been a while, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I've always been watching you race. ...You've grown so admirable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Admirable"? Not at all...
...It's pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'd have wanted to come see you
with a brighter smile on my face. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, don't make that face.
Well, it couldn't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Teach, what are you doing out on this embankment?
Are you watching over some little Umamusume's training?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No, I've already graduated from that kind of thing.
What I'm looking at now is—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Look, you know that thing.

text_block_list.name: Soccer Player A
text_block_list.text: Forwards, push up, push up! Let's go get another point!

text_block_list.name: Soccer Player B
text_block_list.text:
Run down the opposite side!
Pass the ball around!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Casual soccer... you say?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, some folks I know are playing for fun.
So I'm just here watching.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"How about it, Top Road?
Why not join in for a change of pace?
You like soccer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Well then... since we have the chance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Here it comes, hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road kicked the soccer ball.
It was a lively sight that I hadn't seen in quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
So, you came today... for advice?
To counter that horse girl who has completely transformed.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Damn, she's undergone one hell of an evolution. I've never seen an Umamusume like that before.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That toughness. That strength in her legs.
It's almost as if...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: He's a European soccer player.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, European competitors have a different level of physical strength.
In a standard contest of power, you wouldn't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, since long ago, there have been many youths
in this country who dreamed of
'making a mark in the European league.'"

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
So, they went over to Europe, but...
they say at first, they were totally outclassed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Teacher. You analyzed it
from an entirely different angle.
Yes, T.M. Opera O is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like a European soccer player.
How will we face such a formidable wall?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, Teacher!
Are you talking about something important?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please let me join in too.
I would love to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Narita Top Road.
Well then, here's a soccer trivia question for ya.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: A few decades ago, domestic soccer players stood no chance in Europe at all. But...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
There are many athletes active on that stage now.
—Why did it become viable for them?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Why...?
Umm... That is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't know. But...
could it be that "she changed her training regimen" or something?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's another factor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And she studied football over there
even more, or so I hear.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
S-So, which one is it after all?
Are there any others?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
There are many other factors: "bringing in foreign directors,"
"learning the local language," "adapting to the local diet."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Only through accumulating research from every possible angleâ
did we finally open up a path,
somehow managing to break into the international scene.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: In other words, you folks are... just far too one-track minded.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, take a deep breath and broaden your field of vision.
A race is made up of many different elements.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about the training itself.
There should still be endless things we can do.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"If you're interested,
you could try reading up on the history of soccer.
Though you might not be able to apply it..."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Your path will surely become clear.
See you around."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The history... of soccer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sensei!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

The two of us bowed and decided to
head over to the Tracen Academy library.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A 30-year history of domestic soccer...
This is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're completely right, Teacher. I've only been reading racing books,
so it didn't even cross my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It really has been a long history of taking on challenges.
A continuous series of varied trials and efforts...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's not just about a single athlete.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So many athletes, coaches, and managers
tried everything they could possibly think of—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even when things didn't go well, the next generation
of young soccer players crossed the ocean to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "What is engraved in this book is... the history of athletes fighting together as one."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes battling as rivals,
sometimes joining hands as allies, time and time again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, we might not be able to apply it directly.
However, we were able to learn one major lesson from it.
And that is—
choice_data_list: Let's try various things. Stuff we haven't done before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes...! There are many methods I can't test alone. But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I have one too! A friend I can grow stronger with!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're finally here.
Can we train?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...! Were you waiting for me?
Since when...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it.
I always believed you'd come.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san. You... told me that, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's always a way, I'm telling you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, then it must be there.
Even if I can't see it right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen...
Surpass Opera O, and the road continues beyond.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to walk down that path. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you can't move forward, I'll go on alone.
What about you... what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, the path leading to the future is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it never would have happened.
If it had just been me all alone."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Opera O-chan is really that strong.
And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's no path, I'll carve one out!
Because I have—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because Ayabe-san is here!
A fellow Umamusume to hone each other's skills with.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—I'll do it.
I don't really... like chatting, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're going to prepare a
training menu for tandem running, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as many as you want!
Yeah, as many as you want!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaahhh!!
HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...
Ayabe-san, show me even more patterns!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes... I will surpass them—both Opera O and you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road now treads the same path that the soccer boys once walked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racing and soccer are different sports.
However, they share common ground even off the field.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text: Top Road, Madam President, thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck in the Takarazuka Kinen!!
I'm rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... A visitor... at this late hour?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... she was waiting for me.
Just like Ayabe-san was.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You went out of your way just to cheer for me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm truly humbled. There are so many people
both inside and outside Tracen Academy cheering us on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Surely this is an important strength as well. Yes,
just like the 12th player in soccer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The power of supporters! I believe this is what
has carried so many athletes forward.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The power of supporters... I don't really understand it.
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like they'll be in the way.
Let's continue training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Two people taking on a massive wall.
Narita Top Road has the power of everyone's support, and beside her is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was indeed a star that illuminated
a path that should have been invisible.
